paper_metadata.title: Improving the microstructure and high temperature properties of the Ti-40Al-16Nb alloy by the addition of a minor Sc or La-rich Misch metal

evidence.quote: This work investigated the effect of a slight increase in Nb content of approximately 1 at.% and the effect of adding a minor Sc or La-rich Misch metal (Mm) on the microstructure, phases and high temperature properties of Ti-40Al-15Nb alloy.
Titanium aluminide intermetallic alloys are highly promising for high-temperature structural applications [1-3].

evidence.section: 3.1. Microstructural analysis and phases characterization of as-cast alloys
evidence.quote: Adding 0.39wt.%Mm to the Ti-40Al-16Nb alloy yields precipitates of very fine white granular-like particles in the a2 phase matrix [Fig. 4(d)]. EDX spectrum [(Fig. 6(b)] and EPMA analysis determine that the fine white granular-like precipitates contain most of the La and O. The stoichiometric ratio between La and O is around 2:3, suggesting that the precipitates are La2O3.
